item.title: Best Core Keeper Starting Seed — Seeds for a Smooth First Session (1.3.0.6)
item.description: A good starting seed buys you the first hour of Core Keeper: loot close to the Core, a peaceful meadow to grab early wool and milk, and no 20-tunnel dig just to find copper. This page lists the community-verified starting seeds we trust — every entry traces back to a Reddit, Discord or press roundup source. For how seeds actually shape your world, read the Seeds guide. Why we recommend these seeds Seed What you get Who it’s for 400957925946 Useful starter items near spawn First-timers who want a frictionless opening 1 Meadow sub-biome north of the Core Anyone who wants Moolin / Bambuck immediately 186511372992 Meadow sub-biome southeast of the Core Fallback if seed 1 feels cramped None of these “cheat” the game — they just put the fixed, seed-locked features (a meadow, starter chests) on a short leash from The Core.
